text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: After the Osaka Hai, Maruzensky begins to train harder than ever.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: At the same time, she is worried about Grass Wonder and Special Week, who seem disheartened…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Maruzensky's fears are proven correct when Grass Wonder suffers an injury.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Maruzensky can't just stand by as they overexert themselves, so she tells them about the importance of having fun.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Taking her advice, the two athletes successfully get back on track.
